# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged to elderly  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P49](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0049), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; Married  <sub>[v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- **Rank:** Farmer and landowner  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, bald man with prominent blue eyes and a fringe of hair around his ears. When angry, his round face turns purple. After reconciling with his wife, he becomes spruced up, clean-shaved, and neatly dressed in mended clothes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

## Personality

Irritable and blunt, Mr. Harrison prides himself on being extremely outspoken and telling the plain truth regardless of others' feelings. Despite his crusty exterior, he possesses a soft spot for youth, a dry sense of humor, and an underlying warmth that makes him a good friend once understood. He is averse to strict tidiness and domestic rules, preferring a leisurely, unbothered lifestyle. Though quick to temper, he is fair-minded enough to admit his own mistakes and make amends.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023), [v2 c2 P39](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0039), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

Mr. J. A. Harrison bought the Robert Bell farm in Avonlea, adjoining Green Gables, and moved there as a newcomer. His unconventional housekeeping, erratic meal times, and loud profanity-uttering parrot, Ginger, quickly earned him the reputation of an eccentric crank in the village. Soon after his arrival, he confronted Anne Shirley over her Jersey cow breaking into his oatfield, causing a fiery exchange of insults between them. However, when Anne accidentally sold his cow instead of her own, she went to his house to confess and apologize; Mr. Harrison accepted the mistake graciously, exchanged cows with her, and the two became firm friends. He later joined and supported the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. After his parrot was killed during a freak thunderstorm, Mr. Harrison's estranged wife, Emily, arrived at his home, having misconstrued a newspaper joke as a sign he was re-marrying. ## Background by volume

- Grew up in New Brunswick and was spoiled by a sister who kept house for him  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Married Emily Scott to fulfill a promise to his dying sister  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Separated from his wife over domestic friction and his swearing parrot, Ginger  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)</sub>
- Moved to Prince Edward Island to live as a presumed bachelor  <sub>[v2 c25 P51](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0051), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
